description: Alongside its open layers, Togo's open data portal opendata.gouv.tg lists private datasets from the Geodata Togo infrastructure census whose column schemas are public and whose full data are available on request from the producing ministry. Contents: telecom towers for all operators and separately for Togocom and Moov, with location, type and technical capacity fields; tower buildings; buried telephone lines (fibre optic, copper and ADSL, and per operator including the port); cable boxes and connection points; aerial telephone lines and poles; datacentre buildings and their energy supply; and at airports, runways, buildings, energy installations, fuel tanks and vehicles; railway workshops and station buildings. Producer: the ministry in charge of digital transformation and the Ministry of Transport. Coverage: national. Format and access: each dataset page carries a CSV schema (field names and types) and states that the complete data are private and can be obtained on request; the public datacentre and airport establishment lists are open. Licence: listed as other open licence, though the data themselves are not released. Caveats: nothing beyond the schema was downloadable from the cloud on 29 September 2026, so contents and completeness are unverified. Simulation uses: once obtained, the telecom and datacentre layers would support dependency and cascading failure studies between power and communications, and the airport energy and fuel layers support emergency response planning. Related records: the ARCEP Togo market observatory (data-arcep-togo-electronic-communications-market-observatory) gives operator statistics.
